About Me.

Hi, my name is Alex Sommer. I'm a fifth-year Mechanical Engineering Technology student at Rochester Institute of Technology on schedule to graduate in May 2027. I am highly passionate about all sectors of mechanical engineering, and am always excited by the opportunity to express my creativity through design. I have a strong background in modeling, linkage analysis, and structural simulation. I enjoy hands-on environments where I can guide a system through initial conception, through R&D and validation, to hands-on prototype testing, and am seeking a career that will enable me to continue developing these skills.

I absolutely love mountain biking and have been riding bikes in Tahoe and Santa Cruz since I was 7. I am also an experienced backcountry skier, rock climber, fly fisherman, and can generally get behind anything related to the outdoors!
